purpose: One option of a SegmentedControl: a short label, optionally with a leading icon. It is never used alone.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a SegmentedControl.
A tab that switches a view.
An independent action in a joined row.

Checked=true.visual: Raised fill Surface/raised (the description says Surface/input with Shadow/xs); label Content/primary.

Default.visual: The look of its Checked value.

Hover.visual: Unchecked: fill Action/ghost/hover, label Content/primary. Checked: no change.

Pressed.visual: Unchecked: fill Action/ghost/pressed, label Content/primary. Checked: no change.

Focused.visual: Border/focus inside plus a Border/ring/default ring, over the Checked look.

Disabled.meaning: Cannot be chosen; skipped by the arrow keys.
Disabled.visual: Label Content/disabled; a checked item keeps its raised fill.

a11y.keyboard: The group owns the roving tab stop and the arrow keys; the item has no keys of its own.
notes: With LabelVisible false the item needs an aria-label.
Fill and ink change with the motion role use-hover (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Checked fill: the bindings say Surface/raised, the description and the human contract say Surface/input with Shadow/xs, and Surface/raised equals Surface/muted in Dark (findings FIG-003, COL-002 SYN-003). Which role, and what is the new role's name?
Contrast: unchecked labels are Content/secondary on Surface/muted, 4.22:1 in Light. Fix the role or accept?
Reduced motion: should the use-hover colour change stay as a short fade or become instant?
